# Inventory — what already exists

**Check this before creating any component, hook, constant, type, or util.**
If a near match exists, extend it. Creating a second one is a review failure.

**Specs do not edit this file.** Specs run in parallel, so each one records what
it created in its own fragment, `specs/inventory/NN-<slug>.md`, using the entry
shape below. Read this file **and** every fragment before creating anything.
The verification pass (spec 34) folds the fragments in here.

Greenfield project: at planning time (2026-11-07) the repo held only
`lensadvisor_blueprint.html`, so every section is empty.

Entry shape — three lines, with a stable anchor so specs can cite
`INVENTORY.md#<anchor>`:

```markdown
### `<anchor-name>`
`<path>` — <one-line purpose>
**Use instead of:** <what not to build>
**Added by:** spec NN.
```
